'''Gil Kogan''' was a petty criminal who had a passing resemblance to [[Hahz Fallone]]. In order to ingratiate himself with Hahz, he agreed to be a stand-in during a kidnapping attempt by several [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]].
